description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldBool, which extends SugarWidgetReportField. It provides methods for handling boolean fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM reports and displays, including query filtering, list display, and input controls.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldBool
classes.description: A widget class for boolean field display and filtering in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM reports.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Generates SQL filter clause for equality comparison of boolean fields based on input value.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns an HTML snippet displaying a checkbox or a boolean string for list views.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Replicates the behavior of queryFilterEquals for 'starts with' filter, suitable for boolean fields.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Returns an HTML select element for inputting boolean values ('yes' or 'no') in forms.
